description: Set a character's base animation and/or its playback settings. Partial and absolute: pass (group, category, no) together to load a clip from the catalog (ids from studio_search_catalog with catalog='anime'), and/or pass speed/pattern/option_param1/option_param2 to adjust how the current clip plays. Loading a clip only changes the animation — it does not touch IK/FK targets, expressions or hand shapes; use studio_set_character_pose for a full body pose. The anime catalog is not sex-filtered (Studio does not filter it either), so a clip authored for the other sex will load but may look wrong. The playback settings are pushed onto Studio's undo stack and can be undone from the UI; loading a clip cannot.

group.description: catalog group; must be given together with 'category' and 'no'

normalized_time.description: where to start inside the clip, in Unity normalized time: the fractional part is the position in the clip, the integer part is the loop count. 0..1 covers one pass. Defaults to 0. Only applies when loading a clip.

speed.description: playback speed, 1 = normal, 0 freezes the animation on its current frame

pattern.description: clip variation, only reaches the animator when the loaded clip declares one — check 'anime.is_anime_motion' from studio_list_characters, otherwise the value is stored but does nothing

option_param1.description: first clip-specific parameter; only effective when 'anime.is_h_anime' is true

option_param2.description: second clip-specific parameter; same condition as 'option_param1'

output.description: the character, same shape as one entry of studio_list_characters
